lines.text: Welcome back through the Gate. Debrief, please.
The foundation is braced. It will carry people long after anyone remembers why.
The Dominion has its stone. The Span has a countdown. Remember that you chose this.
The grazers remember being hit. So do I.
And the beetles walked away. Nobody had to win.
One more thing. A Dust Grazer was injured near the drill site. We brought it back under Protective Extraction. It needs a Habitat.
